name: Trioteca Hipotecas
description: Calcula la cuota de tu hipoteca, los impuestos de compra y los ratios de asequibilidad en un solo lugar. Compara escenarios, entiende el coste total de comprar una vivienda y comprueba cómo cambian los resultados al modificar la entrada, el plazo o el tipo de interés. Si necesitas más contexto, la app también puede mostrarte información hipotecaria fundamentada para ayudarte a entender los números antes de seguir con tu búsqueda.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Trioteca Hipotecas to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Trioteca Hipotecas to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.trioteca.com/mortgage.

_published_faq.name: Is Trioteca Hipotecas MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Trioteca Hipotecas scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Trioteca Hipotecas MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trioteca Hipotecas provides these MCP tools: calculate-associated-costs, calculate-mortgage-ratios, calculate-mortgage-taxes, get-mortgage-index, search-knowledge-base, and simulate-mortgage.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Trioteca Hipotecas?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Trioteca Hipotecas in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Trioteca Hipotecas MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trioteca Hipotecas does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Trioteca Hipotecas is developed by Trioteca. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
